description: For an elementary embedding \(f:M\to N\), a tuple sequence \((\bar b_i)_{i\in I}\) is locally based over \(A\) on \((\bar a_j)_{j\in\mathbb N}\) when each increasing finite target selection matches all formulas in any specified finite test set on some increasing source selection; each old parameter \(a\in A\) has target value \(f(a)\).
